purpose: Rehearse the improved post-R76 surface-realization and execution discipline at broadcast scale before real-provider H1. Re-render the exact frozen R76 52-scene architecture with current craft rules, require >=40,000 Korean characters, then externally blind-evaluate against the immutable R76 historical surface.
scientific_boundary: This is Provider-Analog rehearsal, not actual OpenAI API validation.
Historical Control is the immutable R76 sealed surface, 35,333 chars.
Treatment uses the same frozen 9-sequence/52-scene architecture but current improved surface rules and >=40,000-char minimum.
Length is intentionally not matched, so paired result is directional rehearsal evidence, not clean causal proof.
No H1 selected work, Past-Only H1 source, or Human target is used.

current_craft_rules: Dialogue must not explain emotion/state when action, silence, blocking, prop use, expression/gaze, failed action, approach/withdrawal can carry it.
Stage direction may be detailed and must make important changes screen-visible and playable.
Principal voices must differ in sentence length, vocabulary, directness, avoidance pattern, institutional role and conflict strategy.
Avoid repeated document/procedure scenes performing the same dramatic transaction.
Every scene must alter pressure, access, responsibility, information, relationship, spatial permission, or executable choice.
Information must be discovered, contradicted, withheld, verified, physically produced, or acted on rather than merely recited.
Scene openings should establish a visual/action condition before explanation.
Emotion is externalized through performance direction rather than direct self-description.
Detailed directions must remain economical: no redundant paraphrase of dialogue.
forbidden: copying R76 surface sentences as a rewrite shortcut

packet_contents: A/B whole-episode screenplay pair with randomized arm position
same pre-frozen scene sample SC07, SC15, SC30, SC32, SC39, SC41 from each arm
per_judge_required: score both arms independently on all axes

treatment_absolute: whole-episode mean >=7.0 for at least 2/3 judges
surface-craft mean >=7.0 for at least 2/3 judges
no critical violation confirmed independently by >=2 judges
paired_directional: pooled Treatment median is not lower than Control on CHARACTER_VOICE, DIALOGUE_SUBTEXT, PHYSICALIZATION_ACTION, KOREAN_SPOKEN_NATURALNESS
at least 4 of 6 focus axes have pooled median delta >=+0.5: DIALOGUE_SUBTEXT, CHARACTER_VOICE, PHYSICALIZATION_ACTION, PERFORMANCE_DIRECTION_QUALITY, EMOTION_EXTERNALIZATION, DIRECTION_DETAIL_ECONOMY

repair_rule: If Treatment fails mechanical or internal evidence gates before external dispatch, preserve failed Treatment unchanged, localize responsible ancestor, preregister one bounded repair, generate a new Treatment ID, and never overwrite the failed candidate. Once any external judge sees a Treatment, that Treatment is immutable.
